title: SPC Day 3-8 severe-weather contours (US, 2015-2025) verified inside their bands but were about 80 km too tight at every lead day when all severe reports are the truth
abstract: We tested all as-issued NOAA Storm Prediction Center Day 3 and Day 4-8 total-severe convective outlooks for 2008-2025 against the final SPC report database (event: report within 25 miles during the 12Z-12Z day, 20 km CONUS grid). The pre-registration was written before forecasts and reports were joined. For 2015-2025, the Day 4-8 15-30% band verified at 0.274 (95% week-block bootstrap 0.253-0.294) and the 30% area at 0.521, with no decrease from Day 4 to Day 7. But the frequency 0-40 km outside the 15% contour was 0.191 (0.179-0.206), above the stated value, in each of 11 years. Frequency fell to 15% only 79 km (64-97 km) outside the contour, and the result was similar at each lead day and for the Day 3 5%, 15% and 30% contours (76-122 km). A buffer fitted on 2015-2020 (79 km) gave correct contour values on 2021-2025: the added ring verified at 0.175 and the band just outside the new contour at 0.136. The area increased by a factor of 1.6, and the share of event points inside the 15% areas increased from 36% to 49%. The excess was largest on the east side (+0.041 east minus west). Before December 2014, the single Day 4-8 area was defined as 30% but verified at 0.253, which supports the change of its label to 15%. Day 4 areas contained only 9.8% of the observed area of 15% or more, but the frequency outside areas was equal to climatology. Main limitation: the result depends on wind reports. With tornado and hail reports only, the 15% contour was not too tight (0.104 just outside). We did not correct for population or use radar truth.

display.caption: Observed frequency of a severe report within 25 miles as a function of signed distance from the drawn SPC contour (negative inside), 2015-2025, by lead day. Left: 15% contour. Right: 30% contour. Shading: 95% week-block bootstrap. The dashed line is the stated contour value. At distance 0, all lead days are above the stated value. They reach it only 70-120 km outside.

Frequency 0-40 km outside the contour by year. Blue: Day 4-8 15% contour (before 2015 the same single area was then defined as 30%). Orange: Day 4-8 30% contour. Green: Day 3 15% contour. Dashed lines: 0.15 and 0.30.

Left: observed frequency in each probability band (points, 95% intervals) against the stated range (grey), 2015-2025. Right: fraction of the observed practically-perfect area of 15% or more that a 15% area contained, by lead day.
